us-oct19-sabey-umatilla-going-vertical.summary: Sabey announced on 22 July 2026 that it held a Going Vertical ceremony on 15 July to celebrate the first steel rising at SDC Umatilla, its new data centre campus in Northeast Oregon. The release says the project moved from planning, engineering and site preparation into the vertical phase of development, with hundreds of skilled tradespeople expected over the coming months; National Real Estate Advisors is quoted as an investor.

status.summary: Sabey reports that the first steel has risen at SDC Umatilla, its new data centre campus in Northeast Oregon, marked by a Going Vertical ceremony on 15 July 2026 and announced on 22 July. The release says the project has moved from planning, engineering and site preparation into the vertical phase, with hundreds of skilled tradespeople expected over the coming months. Building construction is established; completion and operation are not.

additions.successor_review: The 22 July release is Sabey's latest statement captured for SDC Umatilla; no later completion, opening, pause or cancellation report was found in the 16 October capture of the lane.
